evidence.title: These claims about the new coronavirus and 5G are unfounded ...
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact states that the claim that the new coronavirus is the impact of 5G exposure is incorrect, as the new coronavirus is a virus and there is no evidence that 5G is harmful to people’s health.
evidence.rating_text: This is incorrect, the new coronavirus is a virus and there is no evidence that 5G is harmful to people’s health.

evidence.title: The EG.5 variant of Covid-19 has nothing to do with 5G – Full Fact
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact states that the claim that the EG.5 variant of Covid-19 is a new 5G virus is not true, as Covid-19 is caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus and 5G uses radio waves that do not harm people’s health.
evidence.rating_text: This is not true. Covid-19 is caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus. The 5G network uses radio waves that do not harm people’s health.

evidence.title: 5G Testing Caused the Second COVID Wave? Viral Post Lacks ...
evidence.snippet_en: The Quint rated as False the claim that the second wave of COVID-19 was caused due to testing of 5G.

evidence.title: Maps do not show link between coronavirus and 5G wireless
evidence.snippet_en: AP News rated as False the claim that maps show a correlation between confirmed COVID-19 cases and where 5G wireless service has been installed.

evidence.title: 5G is not accelerating the spread of the new coronavirus – Full Fact
evidence.snippet_en: Full Fact states that the claim that 5G WiFi networks could be responsible for the rapid spread of the new coronavirus is not true, as there is no evidence linking 5G WiFi networks to the new coronavirus.
evidence.rating_text: This is not true. There is no evidence that 5G WiFi networks are linked to the new coronavirus.

evidence.title: No, 5G 'radiation' has NOT caused the second wave of COVID-19 in ...
evidence.snippet_en: Alt News rated as False the claim that 5G radiation is the cause behind the second wave of coronavirus pandemic in India.

evidence.title: 5G Testing is not the cause for the second wave of COVID-19 in India
evidence.snippet_en: FACTLY rated as FALSE the claim that testing of 5G towers has caused the second wave of the coronavirus in India.
